messages:
maria (sec-eng): quick check — are we aligned on what goes into the customer audit export and how they can validate it?
kevin (platform): yes. main design: newline-delimited JSON events, each event includes schema_version, event_id, visibility, actor.role, timestamp. exports are signed and optionally include kms_key_id.
ollie (compliance): must be explicit about PII. proposal: emails hashed (sha256), user agent trimmed, ip truncated to /24 unless tenant contract opts in. include KMS envelope metadata for forensic chains but strip internal host/node ids.
lucy (product): product needs deterministic actor.role values and stable event_id so customers can build filters and dedupe. also expose a human-readable action string.
kevin (platform): visibility levels: public | tenant-admin | platform-admin. API enforces via RBAC and token scopes. scoped-token example:
```
{
  "sub": "svc-ingest",
  "tenant": "t-58a7",
  "scopes": ["audit:read:tenant","audit:read:tenant-admin"]
}
```
only tokens with audit:read:tenant-admin can access tenant-admin events.
maria (sec-eng): how do we prevent leaks during partial exports or failovers?
rafi (eng-sre): make sure exporters redact on the writer side not after aggregation. add chaos tests that simulate node restarts and incomplete bundles to assert no internal ids slip out. also make per-deployment toggle: hosted default = platform-admin events removed unless tenant opt-in, dedicated = controlled by contract/flag.
alina (support): for customer validation docs: include step-by-step curl + openssl examples to verify signatures and a minimal canonicalization rule (utf8, stable key order). customers will want sample code in python and jq.
kevin (platform): signing plan: HMAC not great cross-tenant. we'll sign with customer KMS-wrapped keys when tenant provides, otherwise platform-signed with kms_key_id included. event.signature will be base64 of the sig over canonicalized JSON. include event.kms_key_id and signature_alg.
ollie (compliance): one more: add `redaction_level` per event (none | partial | full) so export tooling can map visibility -> redaction deterministically. document exactly which fields are removed vs hashed.
lucy (product): request: add `seq` per-tenant monotonic integer to help clients assert completeness. make it optional for privacy-forward exports.
kevin (platform): agreed. technical constraints: seq must never be globally meaningful (no shard ids). store seq in tenant namespace. migration plan: publish schema_version=2 with these fields; support v1 for 30 days, warn clients.
maria (sec-eng): tests: unit tests for redaction, RBAC integration tests for token scopes, and an export-verification e2e using test KMS keys.
rafi (eng-sre): add monitoring for export failures and a small audit of outgoing bundles (hash-only logs) to detect malformed exports without exposing payloads.
alina (support): action for docs: example of verifying a signed ndjson file, and a table showing fields present per visibility. I'll draft.
kevin (platform): I'll open PR for schema v2 + signing + scope enforcement. will include canonicalization doc and sample jwt claim checks.
maria (sec-eng): deployment note: canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC for audit-export-service. deploy-bot: please run canary and capture export artifacts to review.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: audit-export-service:canary -> 02:00 UTC tomorrow
kevin (platform): thanks. I'll add feature flag to disable platform-admin visibility in hosted by default.
ollie (compliance): legal/consent: hosted tenants must opt-in to receive unredacted platform-admin events. add consent checkbox in admin UI.
maria (sec-eng): outstanding owners:
- kevin: PR for schema v2, signing, scope enforcement
- ollie: final PII redaction table and policy
- lucy: product UI & filter spec for roles/visibility
- rafi: chaos tests + infra flag per-deployment
- alina: customer verification doc + examples
we'll regroup after PR review. :thumbsup:
